paper_title: LLM4SZZ: Enhancing SZZ Algorithm with Context-Enhanced Assessment on Large Language Models

selection.note: mineru key is unreliable; blocks are selected by title/body/inheritance. rescued_from_other counts sections labeled other but treated as typed roles.

claims.statement: LLM4SZZ outperforms all baselines across three datasets, improving F1-score by 6.9% to 16.0% without significantly sacrificing recall.
claims.evidence_quote: LLM4SZZ outperforms all baselines across three datasets, improving F1-score by 6.9% to 16.0% without significantly sacrificing recall.

claims.statement: LLM4SZZ improves precision over all baselines by 2.4% to 9.2% across the evaluated datasets.
claims.evidence_quote: with an increase in precision from 2.4% to 9.2%.

claims.statement: LLM4SZZ identifies bug-inducing commits that baselines miss, accounting for 7.8%, 7.4%, and 2.5% of total bug-inducing commits across the three datasets, respectively.
claims.evidence_quote: accounting for 7.8%, 7.4% and 2.5% of the total bug-inducing commits across three datasets, respectively.

claims.statement: LLM4SZZ has more consistent cross-dataset performance; even in the worst case, it outperforms other baselines by at least 6.9% in F1-score.
claims.evidence_quote: In the worst scenario, it can still outperform other baselines by 6.9% in F1-score.

claims.statement: LLM4SZZ improves precision and F1-score without substantial recall loss, achieving higher recall than all baselines except B-SZZ in all three datasets.
claims.evidence_quote: LLM4SZZ improves both precision and F1-score without a substantial sacrifice in recall. In all three datasets, LLM4SZZ achieves a higher recall than all other baselines, except for the B-SZZ algorithm.
